basic_info.description: Welcome to Waterfront Living at The Shipyard! This stunning 1,044 sq. ft. corner home offers breathtaking views of downtown San Francisco, the Bay Bridge, and the water. Filled with natural light from two sides, this open and airy residence seamlessly blends the family room, kitchen, and dining area. The modern kitchen features GE stainless steel appliances, Silestone quartz countertops, a Bianca Calcutta backsplash, and a spacious island, with a private balcony overlooking the mews. Thoughtfully positioned on opposite ends for privacy, the two bedrooms include a luxurious owner's suite with a walk-in closet and spa-inspired en-suite bathroom. High ceilings, hardwood floors, and one-car parking add to the home's appeal. The Madison, Lennar's newest collection, offers premium amenities, including a stylish lobby, a Pavilion with a lounge and fitness center, a dog washing station, bike storage, and a courtyard with BBQ facilities. Located in the vibrant Hunters Point-Bayview neighborhood, this home enjoys one of San Francisco's best microclimates and easy access to parks, trails, downtown, highways 101/280, UCSF Mission Bay, Dogpatch, and Mission Bay.
